title.narrative: UNJP - SDG Business Partnerships and Solutions
UNJP - SDG Business Partnerships and Solutions

description.narrative: Att stödja albanska företag att implementera hållbara affärsmetoder som kommer att vara katalytiska för att göra det möjligt för den lokala privata sektorn att ha en positiv inverkan på albansk ekonomi, klimat och samhälle. De direkta förmånstagarna kommer att vara albanska företag, nämligen deras ägare och deras arbetskraft samt lokala och centrala statliga institutioner. Särskild uppmärksamhet kommer att ägnas åt att rikta in sig på kvinnor, ungdomar och utsatta grupper. Andra relevanta intressenter kommer att vara branschorganisationer, handelskamrar, internationella företag, universitet och finansiella institutioner.

To support Albanian companies in implementing sustainable business practices which will be catalytic in enabling the local private sector in having a positive impact on Albanian economy, climate and society.The direct beneficiaries will be Albanian companies, namely their owners and their workforce as well as local and central government institutions. Specific attention will be paid to targeting women, young people and vulnerable groups. Other relevant stakeholders will be sectoral associations, chambers of commerce, international companies, universities and financial institutions.

The overall objective of this Project is to raise the awareness among private sector actors about SDGs and the ways businesses will benefit from them and contribute to their implementation in Albania. Indeed, in addition to offering a wealth of expertise and disruptive innovation, businesses can help mobilize much needed capital in support of the SDGs, while reorienting their strategies to create value not just for their shareholders, but society at large.
The main project objective will be achieved through two main Outcomes:
Outcome 1. Technical Capacity Companies are equipped with technical knowledge and skills to implement sustainable practices and move towards higher value added business models.
Outcome 2. Enabling Environment Companies are aware of sustainable practices, connected to academia and to national and international business opportunities to upgrade them as well as in active communication with policy makers while consumers increasingly value sustainability.

title.narrative: Amendment No 3 to the Standard Administrative Agreement on SDG Fund II Albania
Decision on Contribution for a UNJP on Business Partnerships and Solutions for SDG

description.narrative:
Januar December 2024 was the first year of the implementation and was dedicated to piloting joint approaches between the agencies regarding capacity building activities for SMEs and tightening the engagement of the business community through strategic communication activities and events.
Regarding Outcome 1, the strength points of implementation have been the pilots of joint approaches undertaken by the agencies. Those revolved around the two focus sectors: TCLF for ILO and UNIDO agrobusiness for FAO and UNDP. - UNIDO and ILO developed a comprehensive initiative, Innovative Solutions for Efficient and Sustainable TCLF Enterprises (ISES), which combines tools from the Sustaining Competitive and Responsible Enterprises (SCORE) and the Resource Efficient and Cleaner Production (RECP) methodologies. In the second part of 2024, the implementation rates were brought to promising levels, with 35 companies expressing their interest in participating and most of them were visited to identify the improvements potential. A comprehensive mapping report on the TCLF sector in Albania was drafted by the ILO in collaboration with IndustriALL and a survey of SMEs was launched along with refreshment training for local experts. - At the same time, UNDP and FAO piloted a collaboration in engaging the local Municipality of Lushnja, with FAO undertaking a thorough agricultural sector value chain analysis while UNDP identified and is currently supporting 11 agroprocessing businesses through the "Growing with Your Business" methodology. The first implementation in the scope of the project is expected to be concluded in the early months of 2025 while the agencies will strategize for the identification of the next local value chain for the upcoming rollout.
Regarding Outcome 2, results have been excellent in business engagement, through a successful communications campaign and organisation of events such as the SDG Business Pioneers Award 2024.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
